The '''Dianoga Swamp Trap''' was a [[Shift-Vertical]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. A more dangerous version of the [[Rancor Pit]], the obstacle included a pool of swamp water below the inverted middle fence. Riders who overcompensate would plunge their [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] into the water, which also usually included a [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] that had been starved.<ref name="BSS" />
